CustomField.description: True when this event terminates the Eichfrist early. Either it is an Eingriff under § 37 Abs. 2 Nr. 2, or it is an Instandsetzung that fails to meet all four Abs. 5 conditions together and so falls back to Abs. 2 Nr. 2. The four-way AND is the statute, not a house rule.
CustomField.formula: ISPICKVAL(Typ__c, 'Eingriff') || ( ISPICKVAL(Typ__c, 'Instandsetzung') && NOT( AND( Instandsetzer_befugt__c, Nacheichung_beantragt__c, Kennzeichnung_41__c, Behoerde_informiert__c ) ) )
CustomField.label: Beendet Eichfrist vorzeitig
